La Caisse increased its stake from 15% to a pro forma 30% and rolled a post-closing investment; Brookfield takes the remaining 70% and is the control/lead sponsor. Corroborated by Boralex's own press release, La Caisse's own press release, Brookfield Renewable's (bep.brookfield.com) own release, and GlobeNewswire - four-way primary confirm, hence verified/Tier-1 despite this session's WebFetch access being blocked for direct re-reads (see summary.md operational note).
